reading.changingLinesHelpBody:
Changing lines show where the structure of the situation has already lost stability.

They do not mark individual events, but places of tension, transition, or excess, through which one form gradually changes into another.

Each changing line points to a phase of the process where movement can no longer remain unchanged.
reading.primaryHexagramHelpBody:
The entry hexagram shows the form from which movement begins.

It describes the initial state of the situation: where tension arises, what has already lost stability, and which process begins to change direction.
reading.stateHexagramHelpBody:
The state hexagram shows the current form of the situation.

It describes the tension of the moment, its boundaries, inner order, and the way the situation holds itself right now.
reading.relatingHexagramHelpBody:
The exit hexagram shows the form toward which the situation gradually transitions.

It does not give a final result or forecast, but shows the new state of equilibrium that begins to take shape after the change.
